Routine follow-up visit for an adult male aged 18–34 taking sertraline 50 mg daily.

Patient reports taking medication consistently with no missed doses or significant adverse effects. Mood and anxiety symptoms are currently stable, with improved daily functioning and sleep. Denies suicidal ideation, homicidal ideation, manic symptoms, hallucinations, or recent panic attacks. Appetite and energy are unchanged. No new medical concerns reported.

Alert and oriented, pleasant and cooperative. Speech normal in rate and volume. Mood euthymic with appropriate affect. Thought process linear and goal directed. No evidence of psychosis. Insight and judgment appear intact. No acute distress.

Assessment: Depression/anxiety, stable on current sertraline regimen. No acute safety concerns.

Plan: Continue sertraline 50 mg orally once daily. Reviewed adherence, expected benefits, and common adverse effects. Encourage regular sleep, physical activity, and avoidance of abrupt medication discontinuation. Continue counseling or behavioral health follow-up if applicable. Follow up routinely in 3 months, or sooner for worsening mood, significant medication effects, or safety concerns.
